```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(xgboost)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
```

# preparing data

```{r}
# calculate a sneek variable which is sniff + seek
# for heroin rodents whose seek = NaN, convert to zero
inc_dbl_scr %>%
  mutate(seek = ifelse(is.nan(seek), 0 , seek),
         sneek = seek + sniff) -> inc_ml

inc_ml$drug <- as.numeric(inc_ml$drug)
inc_ml$sex <- as.numeric(inc_ml$sex)
inc_ml$session <- as.numeric(inc_ml$session)
inc_ml$lever <- round(inc_ml$lever)

# prepare factors
x <- as.matrix(inc_ml[,-c(1,7,9,12:14)]) # rest of df minus lever
y <- inc_ml$lever # predict lever pressing 
```


# split data into training and test sets

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(inc_ml), 0.8 * nrow(inc_ml))  # 80% for training

# Create training and test sets
X_train <- x[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]

X_test <- x[-train_idx, ]
y_test <- y[-train_idx]
```

# train xgboost model

```{r}
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)

# specify model parameters
params <- list(
  booster = "gbtree",      # Use tree-based models
  objective = "multi:softmax",  # Multiclass classification
  num_class = 12,           # Number of classes (set it based on your data)
  eta = 0.1,               # Learning rate (smaller values can lead to better accuracy)
  max_depth = 6,           # Maximum tree depth
  gamma = 1                # Minimum loss reduction required for splitting
)

# train the model
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params, 
  data = dtrain, 
  nrounds = 1000,  # Number of boosting rounds
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain), 
  print_every_n = 100  # Print every 10 rounds
)
```

# make predictions and evaluate model

```{r}
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test)

# Make predictions
predictions <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

# Evaluate the accuracy
accuracy <- sum(predictions == y_test) / length(y_test)
print(paste("Test Accuracy:", accuracy))
```

# tuning and feature importance

```{r}
importance <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X_train), model = xgb_model)
xgb.plot.importance(importance)
```
